race.comment: MIDLIFE CRISIS (8) was there to strike when they straightened and made a gallant bid but missed by less than a length most recently over 1200m. Getting to 1400m third-up looks the perfect set-up. IMAMANZOR (10) turned next to last in a big field so his effort to get within 1.6 lengths on the line when resuming last start at Morphettville was commendable. Has won two from three when second-up and this is his pet trip. Big chance. The consistent RONNY BEE (11) strips fitter and will be thereabouts as usual. ALPINE FLYER (6) has a good turn of foot on her day, so watch for her launching late under The King if the early pace is strong.
